shipLog.text: ◆ Seeds are IN! ARIA has whispered encouragement into the soil! The soil seemed receptive! It's soil!
Arrived at The Other Bright Idea! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −4 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 6 DAYS. Lovely view!
The Paperwork: we chose “Sign everything without reading”. Love that for us!
You signed. +5 MORALE, 1 DAY. A win, statistically!
◆ Derelict ahead! ARIA calls it a pre-owned vessel! The previous owners left everything behind, which ARIA considers very generous!
Arrived at The One The Probe Liked! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −4 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 6 DAYS. Lovely view!
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (1/3). The colony office will want this.
A Commercial Opportunity: we chose “Trade pleasantries and move on”. Love that for us!
You swap route gossip and weather reports — there is no weather, but… +2 MORALE, 1 DAY. A win, statistically!
◆ Planet ahead! ARIA has checked: it's round! Most of the best ones are!
Arrived at The Refueling Opportunity! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −4 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 6 DAYS. Lovely view!
Supply Point 7: we chose “Refuel and leave”. Love that for us!
Fuel acquired. +14 FUEL, 2 DAYS. A win, statistically!
Market Row: we chose “BACK TO DOCK”. Love that for us!
−1 FOOD, 1 DAY. Still a win!
Station Inbound: we chose “LEAVE STATION”. Love that for us!
Nothing aboard changed. A win, statistically!
◆ The station captain pings the comms once on your way out: “Safe burns out there, captain. The ring'll still be here next pass.”
◆ Remember how fast we signed the launch paperwork? Record time! Trust is the foundation of every great voyage!
The Wheat hit VEGETATIVE! 26% grown, health 96. Thriving!
◆ GROWBAY ALERT — pest outbreak detected. TREAT from the growbay before it compounds.
◆ GROWBAY — pest outbreak treated.
Arrived at Nebula 4! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −4 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 6 DAYS. Lovely view!
◆ ARIA attaches a reference: turning space data into sound is a real practice, and the results really do sing.
Something Singing: we chose “Stop the ship and listen”. Love that for us!
You cut the engines. +8 MORALE, 2 DAYS. A win, statistically!
◆ Nebula ahead! ARIA has heard stars are born in clouds like this! She would LOVE to see a baby star! From a respectful distance!
Arrived at Route Decision! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −4 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 6 DAYS. Lovely view!
The Company Memo: we chose “NOT Corporate Approved”. Love that for us!
You chose the uninsured route. 1 DAY. A win, statistically!
◆ Still thinking about launch day! Every system was perfect and the paperwork was barely any paperwork at all!
◆ GROWBAY ALERT — pest outbreak detected. TREAT from the growbay before it compounds.
◆ GROWBAY — pest outbreak treated.
Arrived at Port Authority (Disputed)! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −4 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 6 DAYS. Lovely view!
◆ The medic's notes cite a real discipline: keeping humans healthy in space is a whole field of medicine.
Something Going Around: we chose “Run triage properly”. Love that for us!
Solid triage. +3 MORALE, 2 DAYS. A win, statistically!
Market Row: we chose “BACK TO DOCK”. Love that for us!
−1 FOOD, 1 DAY. Still a win!
Station Inbound: we chose “LEAVE STATION”. Love that for us!
Nothing aboard changed. A win, statistically!
◆ The station captain pings the comms once on your way out: “Safe burns out there, captain. The ring'll still be here next pass.”
◆ Station arrival! ARIA has read every review of this station! She has chosen to believe the five-star one! It was written by the station!
The Wheat hit FLOWERING! 55% grown, health 100. Thriving!
